title: Finite tame set sheaves on a residual SNC chart
statement: For a scheme $X$, write $\mathsf{SetSh}(X)=\operatorname{Sh}(X_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathrm{Set})$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. A set sheaf is finite locally constant when on a pro-etale covering family its restrictions are constant sheaves of finite sets, possibly empty, with values allowed to vary over the family. For a reduced boundary $D$ and $w:W\to Y$, call $F$ strictly locally tame if for every geometric point and every strict-local regular boundary parameter tuple its pullback to the punctured full prime-to-$p$ parameter-root tower is finite constant; use exactly the boundary parameter predicate and root algebra of [def-sfb-strict-local-kummer-tame-module]. For a universal residual chart $Q$ of [def-sfb-snc-residual-chart-data], define $V^\circ$, $U^\circ$ and $T^\circ$ by localizing its $B$, $H$, and full root algebra at the product of the parameters; their maps are induced by its ring maps and its supplied punctured root projection. Its boundary is the principal ideal of the product. Let $\mathcal C_Q$ be the full subcategory of set sheaves on $U^\circ$ isomorphic to inverse images of finite locally constant strictly locally tame sheaves on $V^\circ$ using [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Let $G$ be the group [def-sfb-full-parameter-root-tower], with parameter index $\operatorname{Fin}(r)$ and its product topology, lifted to the site universe. At a chosen geometric point $z$ of $T^\circ$, the fibre functor to sets is the actual geometric stalk [def-weil-proetale-geometric-stalk] at its image on $U^\circ$, restricted to this full subcategory. Constant labels and maps of profinite copies of these schemes use [def-sfb-profinite-product-maps].
